examples.title: A Qwen2.5 model lands among Qwen2.5 models
examples.text: Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct is a training model in this fold, so only predictions are shown. Five of its ten nearest neighbours are other Qwen2.5 instruct models (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, Coder-7B, 7B-Instruct) and its nearest neighbour is DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, also a Qwen2.5 derivative. Sharing a base model and a tuning recipe shows up as nearby embeddings, which is what the paper's family and lineage tasks read out. Size does not drive this placement: the neighbours range from 0.5B to 9B.

examples.title: A merge sits next to the merges it was built alongside
examples.text: UndiMix-v3 is a 13B Llama-2 merge from a publisher who released many related merges, and it is held out in this fold (its whole publisher group is). Six of its ten nearest neighbours are other models from the same publisher, and the rest are Llama-family role-play, uncensored or instruction fine-tunes of the kind such merges combine. The release-date and hedging predictions are close to the true values; size (about 10B against 13B) and answer length are underestimated. It has no Open LLM Leaderboard v2 score, so that row shows a prediction only.

examples.title: An uncensored fine-tune lands next to its 7B sibling and other uncensored tunes
examples.text: The 260 paper models include no abliterated model, so this example uses the closest kind the paper covers: a Llama-family model fine-tuned on data with refusals removed. It is a training model, so only predictions are shown. Its neighbours include its own 7B sibling (Wizard-Vicuna-7B-Uncensored) and two other uncensored fine-tunes (Uncensored-Frank 7B and 13B). The refusal-rate prediction is low, but refusals are rare across the whole set, so a low value alone says little.

examples.title: A held-out preference-tuned model finds its base model first
examples.text: gemma-2-9b-it-SimPO is held out: the encoder and heads never saw it, and it was placed from its answers alone (bits, question text and answer text), exactly as an uploaded model is. Its nearest neighbour, by a clear margin, is gemma-2-9b-it, the model it was preference-tuned from. The release-date and base-vs-chat predictions match the true labels. The size head underestimates it (about 5B against 9B), and answer length and hedging are overestimated.

examples.title: A model with no relatives in the set is placed among unrelated 2023 chat models
examples.text: SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct is held out and is the only SmolLM model among the 260, so it has no family to land near. Its nearest neighbours are 7B-13B Llama-2 and Mistral chat fine-tunes from 2023, with lower similarities than in the other examples. The heads inherit the error: they predict a model several times larger and released earlier than it is. Nearest neighbours and the heads only extend what the training models cover, and a model unlike any of them is where both fail.
